verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only one-off texting through the MCP connector and an AI agent (Sona) that answers when the team can't. Neither is documented auto-reply text messaging, missed-call text-back, after-hours replies or scheduled texts. The axis clearly applies to a business phone and texting platform, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
